answer: Implied 2023->2024 factors: A 1.049304, B 1.049330, C 1.049304, D 1.049879. The raw per-tier ratios are not identical, so they are not mutually consistent with one exact uniform factor applied independently to each tier. A and C match to six decimals; B is slightly higher; D is higher because small-dollar rounding has a larger proportional effect. A literal 4.9% factor is 1.049000, which is below all four implied ratios, so 4.9% is a rounded description rather than the exact factor. The 2024 values also show that B, C, and D equal rounded 3%, 20%, and 1% of tier A, respectively, so the official structure can still be driven by a single tier-A adjustment factor plus percentage-derived rounding.

Projected 2025 values using 3.4% and nearest-dollar rounding: tier A $134,897; tier B $4,047; tier C floor $26,979; tier D $1,349. If B/C/D are recomputed from the rounded projected tier A as 3%, 20%, and 1%, the results are the same: B = round(0.03 * 134897) = round(4046.91) = 4047; C = round(0.20 * 134897) = round(26979.4) = 26979; D = round(0.01 * 134897) = round(1348.97) = 1349.

steps:
Projected tier A = 134897. Official tier A = 134841. Rounded projection minus official = 134897 - 134841 = 56. Unrounded projection was 134896.674, so unrounded projection minus official = 55.674.
Exact factor that produces official A from 2024 A = 134841 / 130461 = 1 + 4380/130461.
4380/130461 = 0.0335732518..., so exact factor = 1.0335732518...
Stated 3.4% factor = 1.034000.
Difference = 1.0335732518 - 1.034000 = -0.0004267482.
Basis-point discrepancy = -0.0004267482 * 10000 = -4.267482 bp.
